technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with bullish MACD/Stoch crossovers and Supertrend support, but price remains below key moving averages and volume is weak; moderate confluence suggests caution on swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ALLE shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 42 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; broad market fear (44 score) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but absence of recent news data and stale congressional trades (166+ days) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (459.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinationals, FOMC event in 1 day, and earnings in 42 days create compounded uncertainty for ALLE.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD/Stoch bullish crossovers with Supertrend support and broad market fear zone create technical momentum setup with defined support at 103.90.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages (EMA21/SMA50/EMA200), weak volume (0.68 ratio), VIX crisis conditions, FOMC event in 1 day, earnings risk in 42 days, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction make this a high-risk, low-conviction entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (MACD/Stoch crossovers, Supertrend) offers defined support structure, but conviction is severely undermined by price trapped below all major moving averages, weak volume, and zero fundamental/smart money alignment.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis conditions (459.2), FOMC event in 1 day, and earnings in 42 days create compounded macro uncertainty that could trigger sharp reversals despite technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical score (6) insufficient to overcome fundamental (3), sentiment (3), and risk (2) weakness
decision.portfolio_note: Already 14 positions in Industrials sector; adding ALLE increases concentration risk in unfavourable macro environment without offsetting conviction.
